newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - August 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - August 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Senegal's President Abdou Diouf arrived in Ivory Coast for a four-day state visit on Monday.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan is to inaugurate a commercial arbitration court on Tuesday, based at the Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Abidjan.
